drafts_today.text:
Sensitive skin in your 70s is a different game.

My routine got shorter, not longer: a gentle cleanser, a calming gel, one serum, and a collagen mask when my skin feels tight.

Fewer products. Less stinging.

drafts_today.topic: LinkedIn: auditing my skincare shelf (sensitive skin 70+)
drafts_today.text:
I audited books for a living. Now I audit my skincare shelf.

Sensitive skin in your 70s doesn't forgive much. More products usually means more redness, more stinging, and more money spent on things that don't earn their place.

So I cut it back to what does the work:
• A gentle cleanser that doesn't strip
• A calming gel for the days my skin is angry
• One good serum
• A collagen mask when my skin feels tight

That's it. Korean skincare gets a reputation for 10 steps, but the part I value is the gentleness, not the number of bottles.

If your skin has gotten touchier with age, start by taking something away, not adding something new.

What's one product you stopped using and never missed?
